rationale: The agent looked up a user by name/ZIP and retrieved order and product details, but it then executed two exchange operations without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the jigsaw exchange used a new_item_id that was not shown to have been validated for the requested specs (500 fewer pieces with the same difficulty), and there was no explicit confirmation that the selected replacement met those constraints. The final response also lacked clear confirmation and next steps (e.g., return instructions). Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
